new_result: For every fixed integer m>=1, the positive probability kernels kappa_{m,epsilon}(u)=((u/epsilon)^(2m)/(2m-1)!!)*gamma_epsilon(u) vanish to order 2m at zero and satisfy an exact positive scale-mixture identity recovering ordinary Gaussian heat for every atomless law. Since every target QFORM law is atomless, and account04/B15 proves exact heat-height closure, sup_{epsilon,y}(mu*kappa_{m,epsilon})(y)=||p_mu||_infinity. Thus the full target with constant C is exactly equivalent, without constant loss, to E[((Q-y)/epsilon)^(2m) gamma_epsilon(Q-y)] <= (2m-1)!! C for all centers and scales.
actual_partner_inequality: sup H_m<=C implies H_0(epsilon,y)=int w_{m,epsilon}(r)H_m(r,y)dr<=C; account04/B15 then gives ||p_Q||_infinity<=C.
continuity_status: SEPARATE; this run proves no new continuity implication. Existing fixed-instance C0 results remain qualitatively separate from the universal height problem.
